sequence:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [process where process.name == "procdump.exe"]
  [process where process.name : "*lsass*"]
runs-until:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [process where process.name == "a.exe"] with runs=3
  [process where process.name : "LSASS*"]
until [process where event.type == "end"]
head-sort-pipe: process where process.name == "cmd.exe" | head 5 | sort process.name
sort-unique-pipe: process where process.name == "cmd.exe" | sort process.name | unique host.id
filter-head-pipe: process where process.name == "cmd.exe" | filter host.id == "H1" | head 5
multi-filter-pipe: process where process.name == "cmd.exe" | filter host.id == "H1" | filter event.type == "start"
sequence-network:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=10m
  [network where destination.port == 443]
  [process where process.name == "powershell.exe"]
sequence-three:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=15m
  [process where process.name == "winword.exe"]
  [process where process.name == "powershell.exe"]
  [network where destination.port == 443]
sequence-until:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=10m
  [process where process.name == "a.exe"]
  [process where process.name == "b.exe"]
until [process where event.type == "end"]
sequence-runs-first:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [process where process.name == "fail.exe"] with runs=3
  [process where process.name == "ok.exe"]
sequence-runs-second:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [process where process.name == "start.exe"]
  [process where process.name == "alert.exe"] with runs=2
sequence-like:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [process where process.name : "*download*"]
  [process where process.name == "cmd.exe"]
sequence-window:
sequence by user.name with maxspan=1h
  [authentication where event.action == "failure"]
  [authentication where event.action == "success"]
sequence-user-key:
sequence by user.id with maxspan=30m
  [process where process.name == "rundll32.exe"]
  [network where network.protocol == "dns"]
sequence-mixed:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=20m
  [file where file.extension == "zip"]
  [process where process.name : "powershell*"]
sequence-process-file:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [process where process.name == "procdump.exe"]
  [file where file.name : "*dmp"]
sequence-network-process:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=5m
  [network where destination.port >= 443]
  [process where process.name : "powershell.exe"]
sequence-three-until:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=30m
  [process where process.name == "a.exe"]
  [network where destination.port == 80]
  [process where process.name == "b.exe"]
until [process where event.type == "stop"]
sequence-filtered:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=10m
  [process where process.name == "cmd.exe" and user.name == "admin"]
  [network where destination.port in (80, 443)]
pipe-tail-sort: process where process.name : "*.exe" | tail 5 | sort process.name
